verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a managed LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation method that scores production traces via evaluators and rules (docs-42, docs-73). It can sample live traffic and run reference-free judges against recorded input and context (docs-62, docs-71). It also runs inside offline experiments via `run_experiment` (docs-63, docs-70), and scores can be numeric, categorical, or boolean (docs-47). A community report says a blog claimed LLM-as-judge is unavailable in free/self-hosted versions, but that concerns tier availability, not whether the capability works, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the configurable parts (custom judge prompt templates, judge model choice, variable mapping), and independent hands-on corroboration of the managed evaluators.
